# Tanish Anand

16. Co-founder and CTO of Vivacity. Research Fellow at IIT Kanpur.

Vivacity is building a simulation runtime for AI agents: persistent world state, actions, branching, simulation routing, verification, and commit. The portfolio includes an independent browser-based two-body simulation illustrating that loop.
